productName: AIA Voluntary Health Insurance Standard Scheme
productType: medical insurance (reimbursement, VHIS Certified Standard Plan)

trends.whatProductOffers: Reimbursement cover with an annual benefit limit of HKD420,000 per policy year and no lifetime benefit limit, guaranteed renewable up to the insured's age 100.

keyFigures.label: Guaranteed renewal
keyFigures.condition: premium not raised for claims or health changes

exclusionsOrConditions: Benefit schedule sublimits apply per item (room & board, attending doctor's visit fee, etc.); the amounts are not in the extracted text.
Cover for pre-existing conditions is limited to unknown pre-existing conditions.
Renewal premium is based on the prevailing premium table, so age-related increases still apply.
clientSignalPhrases: worried hospital bill will wipe savings
420k a year enough for private hospital
clientProfileFit: Young families insuring several members for tax deduction
Budget-conscious clients who still want private-hospital access
trends.talkingPointTemplate: For {client_detail}, the plan pays up to HKD420,000 a policy year with no lifetime cap, so the cover does not run out after a big claim.
verificationPrompts: Confirm the current annual limit and the itemised sublimits in the benefit schedule.
Confirm the waiting period applied to unknown pre-existing conditions.
Confirm the no-claims discount tiers and the AIA Vitality first-year discount still apply.
sourceEvidence: Lifetime Benefit Limit: Nil. Annual Benefit Limit: HKD420,000 per policy year.
Guaranteed Renewal: Up to the insured person's age of 100.
trends.notesForReviewer: Per-item sublimits and the exact waiting period sit in the benefit schedule, which is not in the extracted text.

trends.whatProductOffers: Reimburses confinement benefits including room and board and attending doctor's visit fee, inpatient and day case procedures, prescribed diagnostic imaging tests, prescribed non-surgical cancer treatment, and outpatient care before and after confinement or a day case procedure.

keyFigures.label: Core benefits
keyFigures.condition: confinement, procedures, imaging, cancer treatment, pre/post outpatient

exclusionsOrConditions: Each benefit item is subject to its own sublimit in the benefit schedule; amounts are not in the extracted text.
Psychiatric treatments are excluded from the worldwide geographical cover.
Day case procedures are covered, but the procedure list is defined in the benefit schedule.
negativeSignalPhrases: expects a cash payout instead of reimbursement
clientProfileFit: Employees without adequate group medical cover
Clients who want scan and day-surgery costs reimbursed
trends.talkingPointTemplate: {client_detail} gets scans, day surgery and pre/post hospital visits reimbursed, not just the hospital bed.
verificationPrompts: Confirm the sublimit for room and board and attending doctor's visit fee.
Confirm whether prescribed diagnostic imaging requires pre-approval.
Confirm the panel arrangement for day case procedures.
sourceEvidence: Core Benefits: confinement benefits including room & board and attending doctor's visit fee, etc.; inpatient and day case procedure; prescribed diagnostic imaging tests; prescribed non-surgical cancer treatment; outpatient care before and after confinement or day case procedure.
trends.notesForReviewer: No dollar sublimits per benefit item in the extracted text.

trends.whatProductOffers: The plan states cover for unknown pre-existing conditions, alongside guaranteed renewal, as part of its VHIS Standard Plan certification.
exclusionsOrConditions: Only unknown pre-existing conditions are covered; known pre-existing conditions are excluded.
The waiting period and any condition-specific limits are not stated in the extracted text.
Certification is for the Standard Plan level only, so benefits follow the VHIS Standard Plan minimum.
clientSignalPhrases: had a scan years ago, nothing found
wants cover without medical exam questions
negativeSignalPhrases: needs cover for a known illness
expects full cover for chronic disease
clientProfileFit: Clients with no diagnosed conditions but anxious about exclusions
trends.talkingPointTemplate: If {client_detail} has never been diagnosed, unknown pre-existing conditions are covered rather than excluded.
verificationPrompts: Confirm the definition of unknown pre-existing condition in the policy contract.
Confirm the waiting period before a pre-existing condition claim can be made.
Confirm whether the VHIS certification number matches the current certificate.
sourceEvidence: The AIA Voluntary Health Insurance Standard Scheme combines essential medical cover with guaranteed renewal to age 100, and no lifetime benefit limit, plus cover for unknown pre-existing conditions.
trends.notesForReviewer: Waiting period for pre-existing conditions not in the extracted text; verify in the policy contract.

trends.whatProductOffers: Premiums are eligible for tax deduction of up to HKD8,000 per insured person per assessment year with no cap on the number of specified relatives, plus a no-claims discount of up to 15% and an instant 10% first-year discount for AIA Vitality members.

keyFigures.label: Tax deduction
keyFigures.condition: per insured person per assessment year

keyFigures.label: No-claim discount
keyFigures.condition: no claim in 3 or more consecutive policy years

exclusionsOrConditions: Tax deduction is a deduction from assessable income, not a direct deduction from tax payable.
The deduction requires the policyholder to be the taxpayer and the insured to be the taxpayer or a specified relative.
No-claim discount is applied on the next policy anniversary only after 3 or more consecutive claim-free policy years.
AIA Vitality membership carries an annual membership fee.
negativeSignalPhrases: needs higher cover than Standard Plan
clientProfileFit: Taxpayers insuring themselves plus spouse, children or parents
trends.talkingPointTemplate: {client_detail} can deduct up to HKD8,000 per insured person, and four insured persons take the household deduction to HKD32,000.
verificationPrompts: Confirm the current tax deduction ceiling with the Inland Revenue Department guidance.
Confirm the no-claim discount is calculated on total premiums of the preceding policy year.
Confirm the AIA Vitality discount is still available at application.
sourceEvidence: Taxpayer who is the policyholder can apply for a tax deduction of up to HKD8,000 per insured person ... in each assessment year, and there is no cap on the number of specified relatives.
No claim in 3 or more consecutive policy years entitles you with a premium discount on the next policy anniversary, up to 15% of the total premiums paid for the preceding policy year.
trends.notesForReviewer: Premium levels are not in the extracted text, so affordability claims rely on the tax and discount figures only.

trends.whatProductOffers: Guarantees renewal every year up to age 100 and states the renewal premium will not be raised because of claims made or changes in the insured's health condition.

keyFigures.label: Claims loading
keyFigures.condition: premium not raised for claims or health changes

exclusionsOrConditions: Renewal premium is based on the prevailing premium for the insured's attained age, so premiums still rise with age.
The insurer may revise premium rates generally; the guarantee covers claims and health status only.
The plan is not guaranteed to be renewable beyond age 100.
clientSignalPhrases: planning to keep this long term
clientProfileFit: People with past claims worried about loading
trends.talkingPointTemplate: Once {client_detail} is in, claims or a change in health will not push the renewal premium up; only age-based rates apply.
verificationPrompts: Confirm the renewal premium basis and any general rate revision clause.
Confirm renewal is guaranteed to age 100 in the policy contract.
sourceEvidence: Guaranteed renewal up to age 100 ... guarantees that your premium for renewal will not be raised for any claim you have made, or any changes in your health condition.
trends.notesForReviewer: Premium table not in extracted text, so the age-based increase cannot be quantified.

productLevelSummary.bestForOneLiner: A VHIS-certified Standard Plan with HKD420,000 a year, no lifetime cap and renewal to age 100.
notSuitedWhen: The client needs cover above the VHIS Standard Plan benefit level or a single room.
The client wants dental, maternity or non-hospital outpatient benefits.
The client already has a known pre-existing condition needing cover.
gapsInSourceMaterial: Per-benefit sublimits and room and board amounts
Waiting periods and pre-existing condition definition
